In the Oldest Stories, Medusa Was Born a Gorgon
In Hesiod's Theogony, Medusa is born a Gorgon, the only mortal of three sisters. The beautiful woman whose hair became snakes comes later, from Ovid. Why Does Anubis Have a Canine Head?
Why a canine head? One idea, noted by the Met, starts in the cemeteries: a watchful canine could be imagined as a guardian of the dead. It is an interpretation, not proof.
